value.rationale: Robust endpoint projection norm maximization across many independent series edge-length choices is naturally a combinatorial design problem whose graph dimension changes with lengths. The structural theorem reduces arbitrarily large integer boxes to corner evaluations; the diamond strictly nonmonotone example rules out a cheaper monotonicity proof. The claim is a universal qualitative optimization statement, not a table recomputation.
